mentions.name: Creative People Survival Guide
mentions.description: A survival guide for creative people that answers common but rarely addressed questions, such as why receiving feedback hurts, how to filter conversations that assess versus antagonize, and how creativity functions as a process of self-care and how to maximize its benefit. The author plans to keep adding topics based on feedback.
mentions.problem: Creative people have questions about feedback, criticism, and creativity as self-care that no one had answers for.
mentions.audience: Creative people like the author, including sci-fi authors and artists
mentions.source_excerpt: I started working on a survival guide for creative people like me to answer all the  questions I was asking but no one had answers for.

evidence.value: I started working on a survival guide for creative people like me to answer all the  questions I was asking but no one had answers for.
